title: No and erroneous basal rate shown
symptom: During a 2-hour warmup after changing a G6, the loop is stopped to have the DASH deliver the basal rate. The main UI shows a line with no rate, and tapping it shows 0.48U/h while the DASH tab shows 0.50U/h. There is also no basal curve on the graph for almost 2 hours.
evidence_quote: Not for me. I've never see it happen again. You can close this issue.
